mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate to below 5.0% indicates a tight labor market, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 5.0%, the 20-day forward return is negative in more than 45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When both GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) show positive momentum in the same month, it indicates a synchronized demand surge that accelerates corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of months with positive month-over-month changes in both GDPC1 and HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 225.0), a month-over-month decline in the CPI index signals a potential easing of inflation, leading to expectations of reduced monetary tightening and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL > 225.0, the 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL declines month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index above 105.0 (relative to 2017=100) indicates strong manufacturing output, which typically translates to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO > 105.0, the 20-day forward return is negative in more than 45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When employment (PAYEMS) rises and unemployment (UNRATE) falls in the same month, it indicates a synchronized labor market improvement, which accelerates consumer demand and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of months where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) reflects robust consumer demand, which typically supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% indicates a restrictive monetary policy stance, which increases discount rates for equity valuation and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, the 5-day forward return is negative in less than 60% of cases.
